decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The sense and Malaysian answer are correct. Indonesian “mertua perempuan” is understandable and attested, but “ibu mertua” is the standard, more idiomatic learner form. The proposed relation “different-common-word” is inaccurate: the forms are cognate equivalents, with Indonesian mertua versus Malaysian mentua, not a false-friend contrast. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
